interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Install speed humps or speed cushions to ensure vehicles maintain low speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and repair cracked sidewalk sections to improve accessibility and safety.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks at the nearest intersections to provide designated and visible crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Adding a buffer zone with vegetation would improve pedestrian comfort and provide physical protection from the roadway.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reducing the width of the parking lot entrance would slow turning vehicles and minimize the distance pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the cracked and uneven pavement with a smooth, ADA-compliant surface to eliminate tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Curb Installation
interventions.description: Install a raised curb to clearly define the edge of the roadway and provide physical protection for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Use high-visibility paint or contrasting materials to mark the pedestrian path across the driveway to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalk along the block to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair and Curbing
interventions.description: Pave the alley entrance and install concrete curbing to define the roadway edge and provide a smooth walking surface.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove overgrown bushes and trees at the alley entrance to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction and Widening
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side and widen the existing sidewalk on the right to at least 5-6 feet.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Road Diet
interventions.description: Apply paint to define travel lanes and potentially add a buffered bike lane or on-street parking to narrow the perceived width of the road and slow traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracks and remove weeds to ensure a smooth, level walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees in the grass verge would provide a better physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds on this residential block.

interventions.title: Vertical Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand warrants, a marked mid-block crossing with curb extensions would reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or common crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming (Speed Humps)
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to intersections to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the pedestrian walkway to at least 6 feet to improve accessibility and comfort.

interventions.title: Enhanced Street Tree Canopy
interventions.description: Plant additional street trees in the furniture zone to provide a more consistent physical buffer and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Ensure adequate pedestrian-scale lighting is provided to improve safety and visibility during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Upgrade existing curb transitions with tactile warning pads to improve accessibility for people with visual or mobility impairments.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Seal or resurface the roadway to eliminate the large longitudinal crack and provide a smooth surface for all users.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers during dark hours.
